title: Understanding the TopK Limitation
body:
Hey everyone,

From what I understand, the TopK limitation of 3840 seems to stem from the NMSPlugin, specifically the checkParams function throwing an error. However, it also looks like there's something else going on at runtime that's causing the values to get capped at 3840.

Is there any way to bypass this limitation?

Would resolving this issue necessitate a significant rewrite of the underlying architecture?

Best Regards!

comments.author: lix19937
comments.body: If you donot want to rewrite code, you can split the `Input` then call the topK several times.

comments.author: Jumaron
comments.body: I made a go around regarding this, but i jsut wonder if the best course for TensorRT would be not to exactly do this or something similiar, splitting the Input in multiple TopK notes? 😶

comments.author: yuanyao-nv
comments.body: cc @moraxu

comments.author: moraxu
comments.body: This existing limitation on TopK's K parameter is due to the current algorithm not being optimal to handle larger K values without potentially overflowing GPU memory. We're currently trying to integrate a different algorithm that waives this limitation, this work is med-priority as of now.

comments.author: sandeepgadhwal
comments.body: Hi @yuanyao-nv @moraxu Is this limit planned to increase in any comming release ?

comments.author: moraxu
comments.body: @sandeepgadhwal I'm still working on that project, so not in the immediate upcoming release but maybe one after that. I will update this thread when I have a more concrete timeline

comments.author: moraxu
comments.body: @Jumaron / @sandeepgadhwal While the current TopK algorithm's limitation is about `K <= 3840`, is it easy for you to determine the max input size `N`, that you ever ran this algorithm with?

comments.author: Jumaron
comments.body: I mean depends, if you can build the engine based on the input shapes, this will not be a problem. What exactly is the limiting factor for the current TopK?

comments.author: moraxu
comments.body:
> What exactly is the limiting factor for the current TopK?

Performance reasons given its design. The advantage of the new algorithm we're working on is that instead of storing all K values inside shared memory, it progressively reduces the dataset in stages and stores the final K values in global memory.

comments.author: sandeepgadhwal
comments.body:
Hi @moraxu 

Do you know if recently there has been any other changes to this limitation ?

comments.author: moraxu
comments.body: Hello. I haven't been able to modify the internal TRT's TopK kernel itself but I added an OSS plugin that incorporates a faster TopK kernel without this K limitation. It will be similar to TRT-LLM's TopK plugin: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/tree/main/cpp/tensorrt_llm/plugins/topkLastDimPlugin but will be in V3 format and will support any axis for the TopK operation. It will be shipped in the next public release, I'll update this thread then.
